deviations.description: Three follow-up task creations (393/394/395) were bundled into one git commit rather than three separate 'task {N}: create {title}' commits
deviations.reason: All three writes land in the same specs/state.json file; git cannot partially stage within one file across three logically separate creates without re-reading/re-diffing between each, which would have been pure overhead under the current heavy concurrent-write load on that exact file. Verified the single commit's diff contains exactly these three additions and the next_project_number bump, nothing from any concurrent sibling writer.
